title: fleischmannia remotifolia
intro: Fleischmannia remotifolia, commonly known as False Boneset, is a flowering plant in the family Asteraceae. The plant has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including fever, colds, and respiratory issues, due to its health benefits such as reducing inflammation and improving immune function. The therapeutic actions of Fleischmannia remotifolia include its antimicrobial, antipyretic, and anti-inflammatory properties, which contribute to its medicinal value. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic effects.
